zh: 走过的范围一定是一段包含0的区间，吃到的苹果就是区间里的所有苹果；所以只需要考虑排序后连续的k个苹果。
对连续k个苹果组成的窗口[L,R]，最短路线是先走到离0较近的一端，再走到另一端，费用为(R−L)+min(|L|,|R|)；窗口整体在0同一侧时这个式子同样成立。
坐标升序排序后，对每个i计算a[i+k−1]−a[i]+min(|a[i]|,|a[i+k−1]|)，输出所有窗口中的最小值。
en: The ground you cover is always an interval containing 0, and you eat every apple inside it; so only k apples that are consecutive in sorted order need to be considered.

For a window [L, R] of k consecutive apples, the shortest route goes first to the end nearer 0 and then to the other end, costing (R - L) + min(|L|, |R|); the formula still holds when the whole window lies on one side of 0.
Sort the coordinates; for each i compute a[i+k-1] - a[i] + min(|a[i]|, |a[i+k-1]|) and print the smallest value over all windows.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort, then enumerate the two ends of every k consecutive coordinates; the cost is the distance between the two ends plus the distance from 0 to the nearer end, which is visited first.

## Proof of correctness

The coordinates walked over form an interval; if at least k apples are eaten, it contains k consecutive sorted coordinates. Visiting that window requires walking over both of its ends, and the shortest route to visit it goes from 0 to the nearer end and then to the other end; when both ends are on the same side of 0, the formula likewise equals the distance to the far end. Hence take the minimum cost over all windows.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
